question: How great is the fruit of offering to the unimpaired one?
premises: Merit arises from all sacred places and all sacrifices.
The offering to the unimpaired one yields fruit.
That fruit is said to exceed the others ten million times.
inference: The rite of offering to the unimpaired one surpasses ordinary pilgrimage and sacrifice in merit.
uncertainties: The exact referent of anāmā in this ritual context is not fully explicit in the verse alone.
plain_english: Whatever merit there is in all sacred places and whatever fruit there is in all sacrifices, that fruit, O beloved, is multiplied ten million times by offering to the unimpaired one.
